caption:
Myth: last date pe apply karna chalega ❌

Fact: jaldi apply karo, aaram se. SOP likhne, LOR mangwane aur documents ready karne mein time lagta hai. Aakhri din website slow ho sakti hai, ek document miss ho sakta hai.

Aapki pehli deadline kab hai? Comment karo 👇
